fixture[.]utils, a name used in fake job interviews

Name abused Package

This name belongs to someone else. The campaign used it without their involvement.

Reported once, evidence reviewed on 2026-10-28

Malicious versions of a legitimate package, installed by a take-home task.

What to do now

If you were sent code, a repository or an app to run as part of an interview like this, do not install or run it.
